sources.title: Chiral fermions from manifolds of G(2) holonomy

evidence.text: Use heterotic/M-theory duality fiberwise between small T³ fibers and K3 fibers. Split the heterotic Dirac operator into fiber and base parts: generic fiber eigenvalues are O(1/α), while zero modes localize near simultaneous zeros of three monodromy angles. A separable local Dirac model determines chirality.

sources.title: The Octagon at large M

evidence.text: Match the running coupling above and below each Higgs threshold, solve for the infrared confinement scale, and substitute it into the low-energy energy estimate. Sequential matching extends the operation to unequal VEVs while keeping M fixed.

sources.title: The Octagon at large M

evidence.text: Reduce the D equations using unitary canonical forms, paired antisymmetric singular values and phase alignment. The output is a convenient radial slice for computing Higgs spectra; global phase rotations require separate care when interpreting the full complex moduli space.

sources.title: The Octagon at large M

evidence.text: Construct invariants of one gauged SQCD factor before enforcing the remaining gauge actions. Epsilon identities, antisymmetry and odd index parity remove baryonic candidates in this application. The same operation requires a different output when M is even.

sources.title: Chiral fermions from manifolds of G(2) holonomy

sources.title: Unification scale, proton decay, and manifolds of G(2) holonomy

evidence.text: Integrate the heavy gauge-boson propagator over four-dimensional separation to obtain a scalar Green function F(P,P′) on Q. Its short-distance behavior, F approximately 1/(4π|P−P′|), distinguishes coincident from separated localized currents in proton-decay amplitudes.

sources.title: Gauge unification in highly anisotropic string compactifications

evidence.text: Construct orbifold actions and gauge-shift embeddings subject to modular invariance, supplemented by quantized Wilson lines. Compare one-loop differential-running coefficients above and below the compactification scale.

sources.title: Strong coupling expansion of Calabi-Yau compactification

evidence.text: Uses holomorphy and zero-momentum axion decoupling, neglecting Yang–Mills and membrane instantons, to constrain inverse gauge couplings to linear combinations of chiral real parts r0 = V and ra = ρωa.

sources.title: Unification scale, proton decay, and manifolds of G(2) holonomy

evidence.text: Expand the seven-dimensional vector multiplet in eigenforms of the covariant zero- and one-form Laplacians on Q. Their eigenvalues give four-dimensional mass squared. Sum helicity supertraces over massive multiplets and express the resulting determinants through zeta-regularized analytic torsion.

sources.title: Unification scale, proton decay, and manifolds of G(2) holonomy

evidence.text: Reduce the eleven-dimensional Einstein action and the correctly normalized seven-dimensional Yang–Mills action to four dimensions. Use the threshold-corrected relation between VQ and the fitted unification scale to connect gauge and gravitational parameters.

sources.title: Gauge unification in highly anisotropic string compactifications

evidence.text: Compare the lowest heterotic excitation with dual type I string or heterotic M-theory KK thresholds; use S/T duality networks to estimate dangerous light states. Separately estimate the 10d gauge-theory one-loop/tree ratio using a cutoff Λ=m_H and group factors.

sources.title: Heterotic Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: Can weakly coupled heterotic compactifications stabilize geometric and gauge-bundle moduli with a phenomenologically suitable gauge coupling, while generating spontaneous supersymmetry breaking and approximately Minkowski or de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Duality anomaly cancellation, minimal string unification and the effective low-energy Lagrangian of 4-D strings

evidence.text: How do target-space duality anomaly cancellation and allowed matter modular weights constrain heterotic orbifold spectra, direct MSSM string unification, and supersymmetry-breaking soft masses?

sources.title: Heterotic mini-landscape. (II). Completing the search for MSSM vacua in a Z(6) orbifold

evidence.text: How many MSSM candidates arise when the Z6-II heterotic orbifold search includes the maximal three Wilson lines and arbitrary gauge shifts? How effective are local-GUT search criteria, and what hidden-sector condensation scales accompany the selected observable spectra?

sources.title: Reconciling Grand Unification with Strings by Anisotropic Compactifications

evidence.text: Can anisotropic heterotic compactifications reconcile gauge unification with the string–gravity coupling relation while permitting supersymmetric decoupling of exotics and acceptable proton decay?

sources.title: String loop threshold corrections for Z(N) Coxeter orbifolds

evidence.text: What is the moduli dependence of one-loop gauge-coupling thresholds for all non-decomposable Z_N Coxeter orbifolds, and which target-space modular symmetries do their threshold functions exhibit?

sources.title: String Landscape and the Standard Model of Particle Physics

evidence.text: How do compactification geometry and discrete string data produce the Standard Model, determine its couplings, and constrain the string and supersymmetry-breaking scales?

evidence.text: Which parts of an N=1 heterotic compactification retain enough supersymmetric structure to compute moduli-dependent gauge thresholds?
